title: Import archive extraction lacks zip bomb protection
description: src/import.rs:86-133. extract_archive() validates path traversal (good) but does not limit total extracted size or number of files. A malicious Mastodon archive tar.gz could contain extremely large or numerous files. The function does use flate2's GzDecoder which has no built-in decompression bomb protection. Since import is a CLI command requiring admin access (not network-exposed), the risk is low, but a size cap on total extracted bytes would be prudent defense.
